content:
# Adding the logs bucket (knr-ops / Flux + ACK + kustomize)

## 1. Base manifests — `infra/s3/logs/`

**`infra/s3/logs/bucket.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs # patched per-env
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1 # patched per-env
    tags:
      Environment: placeholder
      ManagedBy: ack
      App: myapp
---
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketVersioning
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    versioningConfiguration:
      - status: Enabled
---
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    rule:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          - sseAlgorithm: AES256
---
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

**`infra/s3/logs/irsa.yaml`** — IRSA role with least-privilege bucket policy:

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa # patched per-env
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [{
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": {"Federated": "${OIDC_PROVIDER_ARN}"},
          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
          "Condition": {
            "StringEquals": {
              "${OIDC_HOST}:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:logs-writer",
              "${OIDC_HOST}:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
            }
          }
        }]
      }
    tags:
      App: myapp
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject","s3:DeleteObject",
                       "s3:ListBucket","s3:GetBucketLocation"],
            "Resource": [
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-${ENV}",
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-${ENV}/*"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: RolePolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    roleRef:
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
    policyArnRef:
      name: myapp-logs-rw
```

**`infra/s3/logs/kustomization.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - irsa.yaml
```

## 2. Overlays

**`overlays/dev/s3-logs/kustomization.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../../infra/s3/logs
patches:
  - target:
      group: s3.aws.upbound.io
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /metadata/name
        value: myapp-logs-dev
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/region
        value: us-east-1
  - target:
      group: iam.aws.upbound.io
      kind: Role
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /metadata/name
        value: myapp-logs-irsa-dev
```

**`overlays/prod/s3-logs/kustomization.yaml`** — same pattern with `myapp-logs-prod`, `myapp-logs-irsa-prod`, `region: us-west-2`, plus a prod-specific patch pinning the policy to the prod bucket ARN.

## 3. SOPS — `overlays/dev/s3-logs/oidc.sops.yaml`

The OIDC provider ARN/host per environment is treated as sensitive config (account IDs), encrypted with SOPS and applied via Flux decryption:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-oidc
type: Opaque
stringData:
  oidc_provider_arn: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLE
# encrypted via: sops --encrypt --in-place
```

(Consumed by the trust policy through your existing vars pipeline; Flux `sops` decryption is enabled via `spec.decryption.provider: sops` on the kustomization below.)

## 4. Flux kustomization — `flux/kustomizations.yaml`

```yaml
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./overlays/dev/s3-logs
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops          # existing repo source
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-gpg
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./overlays/prod/s3-logs
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-gpg
```

## Notes

- Separate Kustomizations per env satisfy both "reconciles the logs bucket separately" and environment isolation — dev changes never touch prod state.
- Least privilege: role is scoped to a single service account (`system:serviceaccount:myapp:logs-writer`) and a single bucket ARN — no wildcards on actions in prod.
- All acceptance criteria met: versioning enabled, AES256 SSE, full public access block.
- One caveat worth flagging: `s3.aws.upbound.io` is the **Crossplane** API group, not ACK (ACK uses `s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1`). I followed the group you specified; if you're actually on ACK, swap kinds for `Bucket`/`BucketVersioningConfiguration`/`BucketPolicy` under `s3.services.k8s.aws`.
